calls.title: MQL Tasks to Reps
calls.summary: The meeting outlined the implementation of a Sales Lead Notification System using HubSpot workflows to alert sales reps about key account activities like demo requests and signups. The team identified a backlog of over 180 tasks for Jake S., highlighting the need for a refined lead prioritization and routing logic to better balance workloads among reps. They discussed transitioning to a new Default platform to standardize lead routing based on deal ownership. Insights gathered from dashboards will help track task acceptance and workflow bottlenecks, with plans for enriched lead scoring and qualification criteria targeting higher-quality leads. Chris Newton and Jeff Ignacio will finalize the integration details in a follow-up meeting, and training materials for sales reps will be prepared to facilitate the adoption of new workflows.
calls.keywords: MQL Tasking, HubSpot Workflows, Lead Scoring, Sales Rep Routing, Default Integration, Account Fit Score
calls.action_items:
**Chris Newton**
Consult with Graham regarding preferred visual editor graphics and oversee consistent design updates for the editor page (00:00)
Enhance dashboards with lead source data breakdown to improve insight into task origins and routing effectiveness (10:15)
Work with Default team (Dan Veer) to finalize and push Default-based lead assignment launch this week (23:43)

**Jeff Ignacio and Chris Newton**
Define detailed assignment and routing logic for sales reps to reduce overload and optimize lead prioritization (08:00)
Meet to review and align lead scoring approaches including evaluation of HubSpot and Default workflows to ensure optimal integration (25:13)
